labels.en: Pseudobornia articulated scaffold with laciniate leaf whorls

concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept inspected: keep open scaffold but avoid a broad tree of only terminal needle tufts. Correct leaf placement to repeated nodal whorls on thin terminal laterals; exactly four leaves per whorl, clearly feather-like deeply divided laminae. Reduce main stem thickness from generated image. No reproductive structures, consistent with deliberately sterile whole-plant concept.
